policy: Verified photographs with untouched publisher bytes. Manufacturer references establish product naming only and are not embedded content.

entries.author: Cpl. Jonathan Willcox / U.S. Marine Corps
entries.model_review_notes: The official U.S. Marine Corps photographer caption explicitly identifies Drone 40 or Drone-40. The actual cylindrical four-arm aircraft was inspected visually. The manufacturer identifies this product as DefendTex Drone40; not Drone155 or a launch container.
entries.visual_review_notes: Complete Drone40 in flight, showing its cylindrical body and four deployed rotor arms from below at a quarter angle. Unmodified publisher photo; no crop, enhancement or background change.
entries.changes: None. Unmodified publisher-hosted rendition; not claimed to be a camera raw original.
